text: たんパンと　おなじくらい　しんじてる　からな！

structure.jp: たんパンと　おなじくらい
しんじてる　からな！

patterns.name: 〜とおなじくらい
patterns.span: たんパンと　おなじくらい
patterns.explanation: と plus おなじくらい means 'about as much as' the thing before it. たんパンと　おなじくらい = 'as much as shorts'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives it as a reason; here the reason is for the line just before. しんじてる　から = 'because I believe in you'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the state is ongoing; しんじてる is the casual form with い dropped. しんじてる = 'I believe in you'.
